standards.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
standards.summary: Connects agents to tools, data and prompts.

standards.name: Agent2Agent (A2A)
standards.status: v1.0.1 patch May 2026; joined AAIF Aug 17, 2026
standards.summary: Agents discover each other, hand off tasks and exchange messages.

standards.name: AGENTS.md
standards.summary: One instruction file for coding agents at the root of a repo.

standards.name: Agent Skills (SKILL.md)
standards.summary: Folders of instructions and scripts an agent loads on demand.

standards.name: Open Responses
standards.summary: Open spec for the Responses-style model API.

standards.name: OpenEnv
standards.summary: Standard environments for agent RL training and evals.

standards.name: OpenSandbox
standards.summary: Sandboxes where agents run code safely.

standards.name: agentgateway
standards.status: LF project, donated by Solo.io (2025); active 2026
standards.summary: Open source proxy for MCP and A2A traffic between agents, tools and models.

standards.name: goose
standards.summary: Reference open-source agent built on MCP.

standards.name: AGNTCY
standards.status: Linux Foundation project since Jul 29, 2025; AAIF proposal pending
standards.summary: Provides open specifications for agent discovery, identity, messaging and observability.

standards.name: Agent Communication Protocol (IBM ACP)
standards.status: Merger into A2A announced Aug 25, 2025; standalone repo archived
standards.summary: IBM Research's open REST protocol for discovering agents and exchanging messages was superseded by A2A.

standards.name: Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy)
standards.summary: Lets personal AI agents discover and use a company's website, APIs or agent with the user's permission.

standards.name: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)
standards.summary: Defines how AI clients discover tools, skills, APIs and agents across independent registries.

standards.name: Agent Transfer Protocol (AGTP)
standards.status: Individual draft -10 Oct 30, 2026; MCP and Poppy mapping drafts Nov 22, 2026
standards.summary: Defines a transfer protocol that carries signed agent identity and delegation and has a draft mapping for MCP.

standards.name: MCP Apps
standards.summary: MCP servers render interactive UI inside the host chat.

standards.name: OpenAI Apps SDK
standards.summary: ChatGPT in-chat apps built on MCP.

standards.name: A2UI
standards.status: First stable version v1.0 released Nov 11, 2026
standards.summary: Lets agents describe interactive interfaces that apps render with native components.

standards.name: AG-UI
standards.summary: Connects agents to user-facing apps through a typed event stream for messages, tool calls and state.

standards.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP)
standards.body: ACP Technical Steering Committee (OpenAI, Stripe, Meta)
standards.status: Beta (spec 2026-04-17); Meta joined OpenAI and Stripe on TSC
standards.summary: Checkout and product feeds between agents and merchants.

standards.name: Shared Payment Tokens (SPT)
standards.summary: Scoped grants with amount and expiry limits that let a seller charge a buyer's payment method.

standards.name: Machine Payments Protocol (MPP)
standards.summary: Lets agents and services exchange HTTP 402 payment requests, credentials and receipts across payment rails.

standards.name: Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP)
standards.summary: Discovery, cart, checkout and after-sales for agent shoppers.

standards.name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
standards.summary: Signed mandates proving a human authorized an agent payment.

standards.name: Verifiable Intent
standards.body: FIDO Alliance Payments Technical Working Group
standards.status: Contributed Apr 2026; live Antom transaction announced Nov 19, 2026
standards.summary: Binds cardholder intent to an agent purchase.

standards.name: Mastercard Agent Pay
standards.status: Live network program; Acceptance Framework on Mastercard Developers (2026)
standards.summary: Network program where certified agents pay with agentic tokens and sign requests via Web Bot Auth.

standards.name: Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP)
standards.status: Spec and sample code on Visa Developer and GitHub (launched Oct 14, 2025)
standards.summary: Merchants verify Visa-approved agents with RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures.

standards.name: x402
standards.summary: Lets agents and applications pay for APIs and other resources using HTTP 402 and extensible payment schemes.

standards.name: AI Identity Management System (AIMS)
standards.summary: Describes how to apply OAuth and workload identity standards to authenticate and authorize AI agents.

standards.name: OAuth agent grants
standards.summary: Delegated agent authorization on RFC 8693 token exchange.

standards.name: OAuth AI agent instance profile
standards.summary: Many agent instances under one OAuth client.

standards.name: Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG, Cross App Access)
standards.status: WG draft -06 (Oct 31, 2026); basis of MCP Enterprise-Managed Auth (stable 2026-07-28)
standards.summary: Enterprise IdP issues a JWT grant so an app or agent gets tokens for another app without per-app consent.

standards.name: Web Bot Auth
standards.status: WG draft httpsig-protocol-01 (Oct 29, 2026); no RFC yet
standards.summary: Bots and agents sign HTTP requests so sites can verify them.

standards.name: OpenID AI Identity Management
standards.status: Whitepaper; Authority Claims extension in progress
standards.summary: Agent identity plus a record of who delegated authority.

standards.name: Agent Name Service (ANS)
standards.status: Draft specs; Linux Foundation project since Nov 10, 2026
standards.summary: Uses DNS and certificates to name, discover and verify AI agents.

standards.name: NIST AI Agent Standards Initiative
standards.summary: NIST CAISI program for secure, interoperable AI agents via standards, open protocols and research.

standards.name: WebMCP
standards.body: W3C Web Machine Learning Community Group
standards.summary: Lets a web page expose JavaScript tools to browser agents.

standards.name: NLWeb
standards.status: Open source; no public deployment count
standards.summary: Natural-language query endpoint for a website, built on MCP.

standards.name: llms.txt
standards.status: About 10% of sites; no lab confirms reading it
standards.summary: Markdown site map written for LLMs.

standards.name: AI Preferences (AIPREF)
standards.status: Active WG; vocab draft-08 (Sep 2026), not yet an RFC
standards.summary: IETF vocabulary for AI-use preferences, attached via robots.txt and HTTP headers.

standards.name: C2PA / Content Credentials
standards.summary: Defines signed provenance records for media, including AI-generated content.

standards.name: SynthID
standards.status: Proprietary; SynthID Text open-sourced (Apache 2.0, 2024); Detector portal 2025
standards.summary: Google DeepMind's invisible watermark for AI-generated images, video, audio and text.

standards.name: vCon Agent Session
standards.status: Project draft v0.1.0 May 20, 2026; individual I-D expired Nov 21, 2026
standards.summary: Embeds an AI agent's execution trace in the same signed vCon record as its conversation.

standards.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions
standards.status: v0.1.0 standalone release Nov 21, 2026 (Development); adds A2A and agent spans
standards.summary: Standard trace attributes for LLM and agent calls.

standards.name: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API
standards.status: De facto standard; OpenAI recommends Responses API for new projects (2026)
standards.summary: OpenAI's POST /v1/chat/completions request shape, which many other model servers also accept.

standards.name: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)
standards.summary: Open format defining an extensible computation graph and standard operators for portable ML models.

standards.name: safetensors
standards.status: Stable; PyTorch Foundation-hosted project since Apr 8, 2026
standards.summary: Simple, safe format for storing and distributing tensors (model weights) without pickle.

standards.name: GGUF
standards.summary: Single-file binary model format for fast-loading inference with GGML-based runtimes such as llama.cpp.

standards.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
standards.summary: Requirements for setting up and improving an AI management system (AIMS) in an organization.

standards.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF)
standards.summary: Voluntary framework for managing risks of AI systems; GenAI Profile (NIST AI 600-1) added Jul 2024.

standards.name: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (EU AI Act)
standards.summary: Voluntary code to help GPAI providers meet AI Act transparency, copyright and safety duties.

standards.name: Agent Client Protocol (Zed ACP)
standards.status: Schema v1.35.0 and v2.0.0-beta.4 (Nov 23, 2026); supported in Zed and JetBrains IDEs
standards.summary: Any coding agent works inside any editor, like LSP for agents.

standards.name: ACP Agent Registry
standards.summary: Shared directory of coding agents installable in any ACP editor.

standards.name: MCP Registry
standards.summary: Central discovery API for public MCP servers.

standards.name: MCP Server Cards (SEP-2127)
standards.summary: Static metadata describing a remote MCP server so clients can discover and connect before a session.

standards.name: A2A Agent Card
standards.summary: JSON card at /.well-known that describes an agent's skills and endpoints.

standards.name: Open Agentic Schema Framework (OASF)
standards.status: Open spec, Apache 2.0; schema server live (2026)
standards.summary: Standard schema for describing AI agents' capabilities, interactions and metadata.

standards.name: Agent Network Protocol (ANP)
standards.body: ANP Open Source Community (linked W3C AI Agent Protocol CG)
standards.status: ANP 1.2 spec set current (2026); some parts draft
standards.summary: Open protocol stack for agent identity (did:wba), discovery, messaging and payment.

standards.name: IETF Agent Communication Protocols WG (agentproto)
standards.status: Active WG; first draft, Agentic AI Use Cases and Requirements -00 (Nov 20, 2026)
standards.summary: IETF working group defining a baseline agentic dialog management protocol and reference architecture.

standards.name: NVIDIA OpenShell Reference Architecture
standards.status: Launched Oct 2026; joined CNCF Sandbox Nov 10, 2026
standards.summary: Reference design and open runtime for governing and enforcing policy on autonomous agents.

standards.name: OpenSSF Model Signing (OMS)
standards.summary: Sigstore-based signatures that bind model files to their publisher.

standards.name: AIMM: Artifact Integrity Maturity Model
standards.body: Coalition for Secure AI (OASIS Open Project), Workstream 1
standards.status: Approved by CoSAI Governing Board Sep 7, 2026
standards.summary: Three maturity levels for signing, provenance and policy attestations of AI/ML artifacts.

standards.name: CycloneDX ML-BOM (AIBOM)
standards.summary: Bill of materials for ML models, datasets, their dependencies and provenance.

standards.name: SPDX 3 AI and Dataset profiles
standards.status: SPDX 3.0.1 (Dec 2024) latest; 3.1-RC1 (Jan 2026) updates AI and Dataset profiles
standards.summary: SBOM profiles that describe AI models and the datasets used to train them.

standards.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and Top 10 for Agentic Applications
standards.summary: Reference lists of the top security risks and mitigations for LLM and agentic apps.

standards.name: MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems)
standards.summary: ATT&CK-style knowledge base of adversary tactics, techniques and case studies against AI systems.

standards.name: Croissant
standards.summary: Machine-readable metadata format for ML datasets, built on schema.org.

standards.name: Model Cards
standards.status: De facto; from Mitchell et al. paper (Oct 2018)
standards.summary: Documentation of a model's intended uses, limits, training data and evaluation results.

standards.name: ISO/IEC 23894:2023
standards.summary: Guidance on managing AI-specific risks, building on ISO 31000.

standards.name: SPIFFE/SPIRE for agent workloads
standards.status: CNCF graduated; cited by WIMSE AIMS WG draft-01 (Nov 2, 2026)
standards.summary: Cryptographic workload identity that agent-auth drafts build on.

standards.name: Know Your Agent (KYA) / KYAPay token
standards.summary: Signed JWT carrying verified agent, owner and payment info, like KYC for agents.

standards.name: OpenAI Realtime API
standards.summary: OpenAI API for low-latency speech-to-speech voice agents over WebRTC or WebSocket.

standards.name: OpenAPI Specification and Arazzo
standards.summary: API descriptions plus multi-step API workflows that agents can turn into tools.

standards.name: Agent Auth (AAuth)
standards.status: Working Group launched Nov 24, 2026; initial AAuth Protocol drafts proposed
standards.summary: OpenID Foundation protocol for agent identity, delegation, and cross-domain authorization with human oversight.

standards.name: Agent Host Protocol (AHP)
standards.status: Open spec published Nov 17, 2026; used in VS Code and GitHub Copilot
standards.summary: Synchronized multi-client state protocol for continuing AI agent sessions across editors, apps, and cloud hosts.

standards.name: Skills over MCP (SEP-2640)
standards.body: MCP project (Skills Over MCP Working Group)
standards.status: SEP-2640 Final (Sep 13, 2026); Beta extension, Claude public beta Nov 24, 2026
standards.summary: Official MCP extension for discovering and reading Agent Skills (SKILL.md) and supporting files from MCP servers.

standards.name: AI Catalog
standards.summary: Typed JSON catalog at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json for discovering MCP servers, A2A agents, skills, plugins, datasets and models.

standards.name: MCP Events (SEP-3415)
standards.body: MCP project (Tasks and Events Working Group)
standards.summary: Official MCP extension letting agents subscribe to upstream events via poll, push or signed webhooks.

standards.name: OWASP Agent Control Standard (ACS)
standards.summary: JSON-RPC wire protocol, trace schema and AgBOM profile for runtime policy enforcement on AI agent actions.
